cd /work && python3 -c "
from PIL import Image; import numpy as np, math
im=np.asarray(Image.open('observations/obs_0150.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=im[:,:,0],im[:,:,1],im[:,:,2]
px,py,h=2.950,7.400,225.0
hr=math.radians(h); fw=(math.sin(hr),math.cos(hr)); rt=(math.cos(hr),-math.sin(hr))
def bp(u,v,z=0.0):
    if v<=258: return None
    D=(1.55-z)*256.0/(v-256.0); L=D*(u-256.0)/256.0
    return (round(px+D*fw[0]+L*rt[0],3), round(py+D*fw[1]+L*rt[1],3), round(D,2))
tan=(R>140)&(R<200)&(B<G)&((R-B)>15)
print('TAN floor: col -> topmost(wall junction), bottommost(near occlusion)')
for u in range(180,512,20):
    c=np.nonzero(tan[:,u])[0]
    if len(c)<3: print(u,'none'); continue
    print(u,'vt',c.min(),bp(u,c.min()),'vb',c.max(),bp(u,c.max()))
" 2>/dev/null
